title: Senior Product Manager
summary: Lead a product area within Encord's AI data platform and take responsibility for strategy, discovery, delivery, and customer outcomes. You will work directly with enterprise users, define a focused roadmap, use evidence to prioritise opportunities, and partner closely with design and engineering. The role suits an independent product leader comfortable with complex technical products.
responsibilities: Own the roadmap and outcomes for a product area
Lead enterprise customer discovery and validation
Ship products with engineering, machine learning, and design
required_qualifications: Two to five years in product management
B2B SaaS or enterprise technical products
